crossRefs.note: This land we took in possession at that time: from Aroer, which is by the valley of the Arnon, and half the hill…
from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, even to Mount Sion (also called Hermon),
from Aroer, that is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all…
The cities of Aroer are forsaken. They will be for flocks, which shall lie down, and no one shall make them afraid.
Inhabitant of Aroer, stand by the way and watch. Ask him who flees, and her who escapes; say, ‘What has been done?’
No man will be able to stand before you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so I will be with you. I will…
For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right…
Behold, I have made you into a new sharp threshing instrument with teeth. You will thresh the mountains, and beat them…
You will winnow them, and the wind will carry them away, and the whirlwind will scatter them. You will rejoice in…
What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

people.name: Arnon
people.line: A river and valley, serving as a boundary for Israel.

people.name: Aroer
people.line: A city on the edge of the Arnon Valley.

people.name: Gilead
people.line: Mountainous region east of Jordan; tribal territory and personal name.

translations.web: From Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the valley, even to Gilead, there was not a city too high for us. Yahweh our God delivered up all before us.
translations.bsb: From Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Valley, along with the city in the valley, even as far as Gilead, not one city had walls too high for us. The LORD our God gave us all of them.
translations.kjv: From Aroer, which is by the brink of the river of Arnon, and from the city that is by the river, even unto Gilead, there was not one city too strong for us: the LORD our God delivered all unto us:
translations.asv: From Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and from the city that is in the valley, even unto Gilead, there was not a city too high for us; Jehovah our God delivered up all before us:
